Priya (People Ops): Hey team — need panel coverage for Backend SWE candidate (onsite panel Tue 3/24 10:00 PT). 2 interviewers + scribe + debrief lead. Rubric: 60% system design, 30% coding, 10% communication. Can anyone cover a 30–45m coding slot? Also need someone to take notes and fill debrief doc: https://docs.internal/hires/xyz. Candidate will do a take-home + live interview. Prefer someone with hiring pass. Ping me by EOD.
Samir Patel: I can do the coding slot. timezone OK. Prefer to be interviewer, not scribe.
Priya (People Ops): Thanks! Would prefer Samir as interviewer. @Elena Rodriguez or @Maya can scribe? Need scribe to capture 1) code correctness 2) hints given 3) rubric scores + timestamped notes.
Elena Rodriguez: I can scribe but I have a calendar conflict 10:20–10:50 PT. Could do 9:45–10:30? If not I can still scribe and hop in late. :slightly_smiling_face:
Maya: I can cover scribe fully. Happy to take notes + do the quick debrief summary.
Connor (Engineering): Heads up — if Samir is interviewer, please make sure coding prompt is the one in our repo and candidate has run env. I'll post the link and run instructions here.
Priya (People Ops): Thanks all. @Connor please post link. Also quick rubric q: for system design depth, do we emphasize latency/operational tradeoffs vs pure architecture? We usually call it 'scalability + tradeoffs' — anyone object to clarifying that in the debrief doc?
Samir Patel: Agree with 'scalability + tradeoffs' focus. For rubric scoring: 4–5 = clear tradeoffs, tradeoff justification, and at least one viable alternative. I'll add short anchor examples in the debrief.
Connor (Engineering): Link: https://git.company/eng/interviews/coding/expressive-queries.md — use the `expressive-queries` prompt. Run: `docker-compose up -d && pytest -k candidate`. Candidate should have the repo prepped.
Elena Rodriguez: Posted scribe template: https://docs.internal/hires/debriefs/xyz — I added sections to capture hints, timestamps, and scoring rationale.
People Ops Bot: Event created: Backend SWE — Tue Mar 24 10:00 PT. Invite sent to panel. (calendar: https://cal.internal/event/7901234567)
Priya (People Ops): Great. Final ask — can someone be debrief lead to consolidate scores within 30m after interview? If not I'll do. @Maya? @Samir?
Maya: I can be debrief lead. Will compile scores and post summary in this thread within 30m.
Samir Patel: Happy to help with calibration once Maya posts.
Elena Rodriguez: Quick q — should we tweak timing to 35m coding / 45m system design? I think that gives enough hands-on time.
Priya (People Ops): Let's go 45m system design + 35m coding + 10m buffer. I'll update invite and the debrief doc.
Priya (People Ops): Thanks team :tada: — marking thread resolved. If anyone needs to swap last-minute please ping here and include the calendar link and who you're swapping with.
